classifications.no-call-relocation: the symbol is defined but no text section references it: inlined at every call site, or unreferenced by the linked objects
classifications.not-in-archive: no object defines a symbol for the procedure: an internal procedure the compiler absorbed into its host, or a name the archive does not carry
classifications.rename-references: every reference comes from another object: rename the callee's symbol in those objects' copies
classifications.weaken-definition: a reference comes from the defining object itself: weaken the definition, give it a second name, and let the hook take the original name

reading: static: a relocation is a compiled call site, not proof this configuration executes it
what: For every numeric kernel of the call-tree inventory that this configuration reaches, the objects of the oracle archive defining its symbol and the objects whose text sections reference it.  A hook can redirect a call only where such a reference exists.
